title: 1992 AMC 8 Problem 15
statement:
What is the \(1992\)nd letter in this sequence?

ABCDEDCBAABCDEDCBAABCDEDCBAABCDEDC\(\cdots\)

solutions.text:
The sequence is the \(9\)-letter block \(ABCDEDCBA\) repeated again and again.

Since \(1992 = 9 \times 221 + 3,\) the \(1992\)nd letter is the \(3\)rd letter of a block, which is \(C.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: The string \(ABCDEDCBA\) repeats over and over; count how many letters are in one block
One block has \(9\) letters, so divide \(1992\) by \(9\) and use the remainder to find the position within a block
